versions.changelog:
**Lynote.ai feature reference and documentation split from humanize-skill core.**

- Added 70 files, including metrics, logs, images, docs, and examples for workflow clarity and transparency.
- Removed the standalone skill-card; documentation is now structured in dedicated markdown files.
- SKILL.md updated to clarify Lynote.ai as the integrated product layer beyond the open humanize-skill.
- No functional rewrite engine changes; main workflow, editorial contract, and rewrite modes unchanged.
- Expanded documentation for voice profiling, fact-checking, and audience/cognition mapping.
- Added guided examples to demonstrate editorial process on essays and product emails.

- Major cleanup: removed 63 files, including all example content and documentation files.
- Simplified the skill package, retaining only the core SKILL.md file and necessary configuration.
- No changes to the core logic or workflow description; core editorial and humanization principles remain unchanged.

Initial release: Provides a comprehensive workflow for transforming AI-generated drafts into high-quality, authentic author text.

- Rewrites drafts to clarify, specify, and align with the user's real writing voice, using local samples when available.
- Diagnoses and removes AI-writing patterns at lexical, phrasal, syntactic, structural, and cognitive levels, based on a layered diagnostic catalog.
- Prioritizes factual accuracy by extracting, verifying, and adjusting claims before final output.
- Supports multiple editorial modes (Light cleanup, Balanced rewrite, Audience strategy, Deep voice match, Fact-aware rewrite, Publication-ready) depending on user needs.
- Explicitly avoids optimizing writing to evade AI detectors, focusing instead on credible and nuanced authorial quality.
